test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the following graph which shows imports and exports (in ₹ crores) of a company during 2006-07 to 2010-11 and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71f7ccd9f8ee1e388397954b12ef5d3ab4440da77b4f71806f50b1de065cf981.png] 

In which of the following years, the sum of Imports & Exports is minimum?
solution:
**Calculations:**

The sum of imports-exports in year 2006-07 = 1036 + 818 = 1854

The sum of imports-exports in year 2007-08 = 954 + 988 = 1942

The sum of imports-exports in year 2008-09 = 618 + 878 = 1496

The sum of imports-exports in year 2009-10 = 432 + 216 = 648

The sum of imports-exports in year 2010-11 = 685 + 930 = 1615

Here, 648 

therefore ** The imports-exports is minimum in year 2009-10.**
